material_finding: A current same-event B1 exact-score pair has unusually large maker-entry modeled edge while remaining taker-negative; it merits candidate-specific forward replay but is not promotion evidence.

derived_triage.interpretation: The 8.29% break-even completion is only a binary maker-vs-taker fallback stress metric. The live broker instead uses partial fills, a 75% common-completion threshold, cancellation and unwind economics.

generic_forward_maker_context.reason: The forward-maker calibration is a different complete-set strategy class and cannot be used as the candidate-specific fill probability for this B1 pair.
